primary_gt.mechanism_question: reconstruct how rainfall concentration translates into pluvial or urban runoff pressure rather than a generic wet-period label
primary_gt.decisive_evidence: Rainfall concentration and areal or urban-response evidence should dominate; exposure and image products are supporting context.
primary_gt.rejected_simplifications: Reject a one-gauge, one-hour, exposure-only, or image-primary explanation if the computed rainfall-runoff chain is stronger.
primary_gt.bounded_interpretation: The task diagnoses flood pressure and process, not exact inundation depth, building damage, or final loss totals.

event.event_name: 2024 Sudan floods and Arba'at Dam flood

deeper_objective.description: Compute a reproducible numeric ledger for rainfall load, rainfall concentration, surface-change contrast, and mapped receptor context.

formulas.duration_days: inclusive calendar days from start to end
formulas.max_to_mean_ratio: product event-window local maximum / product event-window mean
formulas.dark_blue_pp: (event dark-blue proxy share - pre-event dark-blue proxy share) * 100

criteria.name: mechanism_diagnosis
criteria.description: Identifies the dominant physical process and gives the correct compact answer label or an equivalent diagnosis.

criteria.name: computed_evidence
criteria.description: Recomputes the quantitative evidence inherited from the original task and preserves units, signs, ratios, and key values.

criteria.name: evidence_weighting
criteria.description: Explains which evidence streams are decisive and which are contextual or weaker proxies.

criteria.name: counterfactual_rejection
criteria.description: Rejects at least one tempting simplified explanation using the computed values rather than assertion.

criteria.name: bounded_interpretation
criteria.description: States scale, timing, proxy, or uncertainty limits without adding unsupported losses or impacts.

criteria.name: json_contract
criteria.description: Returns the requested structured mechanism-diagnosis JSON without reducing the answer to a row-only table or same-scale checklist.

provenance.notes: All values are computed from local CSX-054 package files; receptor statistics are evaluated from declared package-relative WorldPop and OpenStreetMap derived fields.
